title: Potential lower bound via the best expert
statement:
Fix $N \ge 1$ experts and $T$ rounds, a loss sequence $\ell$, and a learning rate $\eta > 0$. Then the final potential is at least the unnormalized Hedge weight of the best expert in hindsight:
\[
  W_T \;\ge\; \exp\!\bigl(-\eta \, L^*\bigr),
\]
where $L^* = \min_{i} L_T(i)$ is the smallest cumulative loss over the full horizon $T$.
replaced:
The final potential is at least the weight of the best expert:
\[
  W_T \;\ge\; \exp\!\bigl(-\eta \cdot L^*\bigr),
\]
where $L^* = \min_i L_T(i)$ is the best expert's cumulative loss.
